dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a deep concave falcate curve extending from the apex to the posterior base insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Small pixel radius morphology classified as rounded.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep linear rise at approximately 45 degrees relative to the visible horizontal dorsal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent horizontal white linear scar visible on the upper third of the lateral dorsal fin surface; additional minor irregular white depigmentation marks near the apex.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive light-toned mottling and speckled pigmentation patterns distributed across the entire visible epidermal surface of the back and dorsal fin.
